steps.body: Shoot hoops, win your league, earn new courts & extras, master the online leaderboard. Play for keeps.

steps.title: THREE WAYS TO PLAY
steps.body: Every court has its own league, a time trial and practice. You'll find them all down here.

steps.title: THE LEAGUE
steps.body: 90-second heats vs shooters from the Arcade Cage. Compete in 14-game seasons, make the playoffs and earn titles while gaining XP and tickets each match.

steps.title: LEVEL UP
steps.body: XP fills your level. New levels unlock power-up cards, bigger rewards and new courts beyond the cage.

steps.title: PLAY ONLINE
steps.body: Check the rankings and challenge other players head to head.

steps.title: YOUR LOCKER
steps.body: Equip basketballs and nets from here, along with extras.

steps.title: THAT'S IT!
steps.body: You're all set. Now get shooting.
